integrity: Proof depends on the classical full geometric Hermitian automorphism theorem, with an explicit finite-field congruence calculation; all other stated claims independently checked in proof. Finite verification covers p=3,5,7 only.
scientific_limitations: Exact K-automorphism group for s>=3 only; not geometric extension-field automorphisms, not s=2, not scheme-theoretic automorphism group. Inaccessible closely related May 2026 chapter leaves literature overlap risk.
title: The full arithmetic automorphism group of the one-point Hermitian-relative curve
